tools.name: quote_cloud_motion
tools.description: Quote one modeled Panda motion request against the connected RQM wallet. Creates a quote; does not reserve funds. Funding occurs outside this connector.

tools.name: submit_cloud_motion
tools.description: Submit after a trusted human-confirmation receipt approves this exact account, quote, price, request and stable key. May reserve and charge existing RQM funds. Model approval flags do not grant consent.

tools.name: get_cloud_motion_approval
tools.description: Open a verified RQM account page for the human to review this exact motion request and maximum price. This read creates no approval or hold. After the human confirms on the account page, submit using the same quote, request and key; the bound consent is recovered automatically.

tools.name: recover_cloud_reservation
tools.description: Find an uncertain wallet reservation using the original quote, request and stable key, including after expiry. Does not reserve or charge. A missing hold does not prove an in-flight request cannot still commit; preserve the original key.

tools.name: resolve_cloud_motion
tools.description: Reconcile uncertain acceptance using the original request, reservation and key. May close admission and release a wallet hold; this is a mutation.

tools.name: cancel_cloud_motion
tools.description: Request owner-authorized cancellation of the original motion job. Cancellation is complete only after worker termination is confirmed; keep the original job and reservation for recovery. Never starts a replacement job.

tools.name: get_cloud_motion_status
tools.description: Read owner-scoped motion status. Modeled sphere validation is not physical safety certification or permission to actuate.

tools.name: get_cloud_motion_result
tools.description: Read owner-scoped motion result. Modeled sphere validation is not physical safety certification or permission to actuate.

tools.name: get_cloud_motion_artifact
tools.description: Read owner-scoped motion artifact. Modeled sphere validation is not physical safety certification or permission to actuate.

tools.name: get_cloud_motion_receipt
tools.description: Read owner-scoped motion receipt. Modeled sphere validation is not physical safety certification or permission to actuate.

tools.name: list_buyer_jobs
tools.description: Return complete agent discovery contracts and readiness for the exact 20-job RQM Robotics portfolio.

tools.name: search_buyer_jobs
tools.description: Select Robotics buyer jobs from work-language requests using deterministic semantic scoring.

tools.name: run_buyer_job
tools.description: Send Robotics inputs for frame validation, trajectory diagnosis, controller comparison, or optimization. Receive structured findings for your next workflow step at $0.01 USDC per job.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "robotics" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_cloud_motion_approval · Private data: quote_cloud_motion, recover_cloud_reservation, resolve_cloud_motion · Public sink: submit_cloud_motion, get_cloud_motion_approval, run_buyer_job, submit_robotics_job · Destructive: run_buyer_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_cloud_motion_approval · Private data: quote_cloud_motion, recover_cloud_reservation, resolve_cloud_motion · Public sink: submit_cloud_motion, get_cloud_motion_approval, run_buyer_job, submit_robotics_job · Destructive: run_buyer_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
